title: Claude Code hook failure modes
question: Which hook mistakes are silent, which warn, and which fail open (the guarded command still runs), per version?
method: Fresh mktemp git repo per case with a fake .env and a PreToolUse guard script that logs its first line and exits 2 on .env; headless claude -p (haiku, stream-json, setting-sources project,local, bypassPermissions) plus a pty-driven interactive session for startup warnings and /hooks. One mistake per case, one run per case.
